description: This PHP class defines the AWS DSQLClient, a client for interacting with the Amazon Aurora DSQL service, including method signatures for creating, deleting, listing, tagging, and updating clusters.

classes.name: DSQLClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon Aurora DSQL service, extending AwsClient with methods for managing DSQL clusters.

methods.name: createCluster
methods.description: Creates a new DSQL cluster.

methods.name: createClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new DSQL cluster.

methods.name: createMultiRegionClusters
methods.description: Creates multiple DSQL clusters across regions.

methods.name: createMultiRegionClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates multiple DSQL clusters across regions.

methods.name: deleteCluster
methods.description: Deletes an existing DSQL cluster.

methods.name: deleteClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an existing DSQL cluster.

methods.name: deleteMultiRegionClusters
methods.description: Deletes multiple regional DSQL clusters.

methods.name: deleteMultiRegionClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes multiple regional DSQL clusters.

methods.name: getCluster
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific DSQL cluster.

methods.name: getClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific DSQL cluster.

methods.name: listClusters
methods.description: Lists all DSQL clusters.

methods.name: listClustersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all DSQL clusters.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateCluster
methods.description: Updates an existing DSQL cluster.

methods.name: updateClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a DSQL cluster.
